llm.description: Call an AI model once, optionally providing tool definitions and receiving tool calls

context.label: Context
context.description: When enabled, the selected variable is included as context for this call. When disabled, the model replies using only the current input.

tools.label: Tool definitions
tools.description: Define tools using the OpenAI Function Calling format. The model uses these definitions to decide which tools to call; tools are not executed here. Requests (tool names and arguments) are returned in tool_calls.

toolParameters.label: Tool parameters
toolParameters.typeMessage: The data type of parameter {name} is not supported
toolParameters.descriptionMessage: The description of parameter {name} must be text with no more than {max} characters

jsonParse.label: JSON parsing
jsonParse.invalidMessage: Failed to parse JSON. Check the format
